name: Pod2Swim
subtitle: Podcasts on your swim headset
tagline: Turn pool laps into podcast time. Load episodes onto your OpenSwim and listen underwater — no Bluetooth, no phone at the poolside.
intro: Pod2Swim turns your swim into podcast time.
pitch: Bluetooth doesn't work underwater, so Pod2Swim loads your favourite podcasts straight onto a Shokz OpenSwim — or any headset that mounts as USB storage — ready to play, lap after lap. No phone at the poolside, no streaming, no signal required.

sections.title: HOW IT WORKS
bullets: Subscribe to any podcast with the built-in search.
Browse the newest episodes from all your shows in one chronological feed.
Queue what you want for your next swim — Pod2Swim downloads it in the background.
Plug in your headset and export the whole queue in a single tap, in playback order.
Scan the headset any time to see exactly what's loaded.

sections.title: BUILT FOR SWIMMERS
bullets: Your audio lives on the headset, so you can leave the phone in the locker.
Adjustable playback speed from 0.75× to 2.5× per podcast, with the pitch preserved — fit more in before the pool closes.
Choose Replace All or Add to End on transfer, so you stay in control of what's on the device.
Episodes land in playback order, so your queue plays exactly as you arranged it.

sections.title: SIMPLE STORAGE
bullets: The queue is the single source of truth — add to download, remove to free space.
See total downloaded storage and clear it in one tap.
Optional auto-delete after export keeps things tidy.

sections.title: FREE TRIAL, ONE-TIME PURCHASE
bullets: Download free and try everything for 7 days.
One single purchase unlocks Pod2Swim forever — no subscription.
Bought Pod2Swim when it was a paid download? You're unlocked automatically, at no extra cost.

compat: Pod2Swim works with the OpenSwim, OpenSwim Pro, and other MP3-player headsets that appear as a USB drive in the Files app. You'll need a USB-C or Lightning adapter to connect the headset to your iPhone. On Android, Pod2Swim talks to the headset directly over USB — connect it with a USB-C cable or an OTG adapter. Pod2Swim needs iOS 17 or later, or Android 8.0 or later.
disclaimer: Pod2Swim is not affiliated with Shokz. Shokz and OpenSwim are trademarks of their respective owner. As a Shokz affiliate, Pod2Swim may earn a commission on purchases made through links on this site.
metaDesc: Pod2Swim loads your favourite podcasts onto a Shokz OpenSwim or any USB-storage swim headset, so you can listen underwater — no Bluetooth, no phone at the poolside.

entries: iOS: made for iPhone Duo. Unfolded, Latest and your queue sit side by side, so a tapped + lands in the queue right before your eyes.
On iPhone Duo, Library shows your podcasts next to their episodes, and Queue shows what's already on your headset. The layout follows the fold.
After a transfer, the headset list updates on its own.
Fixes: the trial reminder no longer covers screen titles, and layouts work better with very large text.
Add private and paid podcasts by their feed link — ideal for members-only feeds. Feeds that need a login ask for one; it's stored securely on your device.
More reliable downloads, processing and headset transfers, and no more duplicate episodes.
iOS: auto-delete now cleans up exported episodes on schedule, the app follows your text size and works better with VoiceOver, and Settings and Search no longer crash on a Mac.
Android: unsubscribing asks first and removes all of the podcast's files, and notification permission is only requested when it's needed.
Pod2Swim is now free to download — try everything for 7 days.
After the trial, one single purchase unlocks the app forever — no subscription.
Already bought Pod2Swim when it was a paid app? You stay unlocked automatically, at no extra cost.
iOS: bug fixes and polish, including a more reliable paywall and smoother headset-transfer progress.
First Android release — the same Pod2Swim, now on Google Play.
Global episode search — find any episode across all your podcasts from the Latest tab, with smarter title-match ranking.
More reliable headset transfers — no more truncated or unplayable episodes.
Speed changes now re-process queued episodes in place, and Retry keeps an episode's spot in the queue.
Fixed a Latest-tab scroll freeze, hardened podcast feed and URL handling, and polished wording.
